name: Composite Operator Anchored VWAP Reclaim
note: Picks the composite operator's average cost the way Wyckoff describes it and Shannon draws it: the anchor is the EVENT bar in [i-look_back, i-min_bars] with the largest volume/SMA(volume,20), subject to that bar's volume clearing vol_mult x average AND its low sitting within ext_atr x ATR(14) of the lowest low of the 60 bars ending there. The anchored VWAP is then carried forward from that bar by prefix sums, the setup requires close under the line on uw_min of the last uw_win bars (the accumulated book is under water) with the line itself flat or rising over slope_look bars (the operator is still bidding, not liquidating), and the trigger is the first bar that closes back above the line, above the prior bar's high, on entry_vol x average volume. Short mirrors every clause. Exits are the idea's own: take profit at AVWAP + sig_tp x sigma where sigma is the standard deviation of (typical price - AVWAP) accumulated from the anchor, hard invalidation on a close invalid_atr x ATR through the line, and the structural stop at the extreme of the stop_look bars preceding the entry padded by stop_atr x ATR. Harness target and stop are switched off so those three exits are the whole exit rule. The 250-bar anchor decay in the source is redundant here and dropped: the anchor search window is only look_back bars deep, so no anchor can survive that long.
source: Wyckoff's composite operator concept (StockCharts ChartSchool, 'The Wyckoff Method'); anchored VWAP as an event-anchored fair-value line popularised by Brian Shannon (Alphatrends, 'Maximum Trading Gains with Anchored VWAP', 2023). The practice of anchoring specifically to 'climax/exhaustion bars' and trading the reclaim/rejection is documented in the TradingView anchored-VWAP script literature I reviewed. The anchor-selection algorithm, underwater filter, slope filter and sigma exit are my quantification (synthesis).
code:
def family_init(ctx):
    """Event-anchored VWAP: pick the climax bar, track the operator's average
    cost from it, and mark the first reclaim after a sustained spell beneath."""
    import math
    from collections import deque
    bars = ctx.bars
    n = len(bars)
    hi = [float(b["h"]) for b in bars]
    lo = [float(b["l"]) for b in bars]
    cl = [float(b["c"]) for b in bars]
    vo = [float(b.get("v") or 0.0) for b in bars]
    tp = [(hi[i] + lo[i] + cl[i]) / 3.0 for i in range(n)]

    # --- Wilder ATR, computed here because family_init may not index a Series
    an = 14
    atr = [None] * n
    acc = 0.0
    prev = None
    for i in range(n):
        if i == 0:
            tr = hi[0] - lo[0]
        else:
            pc = cl[i - 1]
            tr = hi[i] - lo[i]
            x = abs(hi[i] - pc)
            if x > tr:
                tr = x
            x = abs(lo[i] - pc)
            if x > tr:
                tr = x
        if i < an:
            acc += tr
            if i == an - 1:
                prev = acc / an
                atr[i] = prev
        else:
            prev = (prev * (an - 1) + tr) / an
            atr[i] = prev

    # --- AV = SMA(volume, 20)
    avn = int(ctx.p.av_n)
    av = [None] * n
    s = 0.0
    for i in range(n):
        s += vo[i]
        if i >= avn:
            s -= vo[i - avn]
        if i >= avn - 1:
            av[i] = s / avn

    # --- inclusive prefix sums, so an anchored VWAP is an O(1) lookup
    PV = [0.0] * n
    VV = [0.0] * n
    a1 = 0.0
    a2 = 0.0
    for i in range(n):
        a1 += tp[i] * vo[i]
        a2 += vo[i]
        PV[i] = a1
        VV[i] = a2

    def avw(A, t):
        dv = VV[t] - (VV[A - 1] if A > 0 else 0.0)
        if dv <= 0.0:
            return None
        return (PV[t] - (PV[A - 1] if A > 0 else 0.0)) / dv

    # --- rolling extreme of the ext_look bars ENDING at i
    el = int(ctx.p.ext_look)
    rmin = [0.0] * n
    rmax = [0.0] * n
    dlo = deque()
    dhi = deque()
    for i in range(n):
        while dlo and lo[dlo[-1]] >= lo[i]:
            dlo.pop()
        dlo.append(i)
        while dlo[0] <= i - el:
            dlo.popleft()
        rmin[i] = lo[dlo[0]]
        while dhi and hi[dhi[-1]] <= hi[i]:
            dhi.pop()
        dhi.append(i)
        while dhi[0] <= i - el:
            dhi.popleft()
        rmax[i] = hi[dhi[0]]

    # --- which bars are eligible to be an anchor at all
    vm = float(ctx.p.vol_mult)
    ea = float(ctx.p.ext_atr)
    ratio = [0.0] * n
    qL = [False] * n
    qS = [False] * n
    for i in range(n):
        a = av[i]
        t_ = atr[i]
        if a is None or a <= 0.0 or t_ is None or t_ <= 0.0:
            continue
        r = vo[i] / a
        ratio[i] = r
        if r >= vm:
            if lo[i] <= rmin[i] + ea * t_:
                qL[i] = True
            if hi[i] >= rmax[i] - ea * t_:
                qS[i] = True

    # --- the anchor at bar i is the eligible bar in [i-look_back, i-min_bars]
    #     with the largest volume/AV. Monotone deque => O(n) for the whole pass.
    lb = int(ctx.p.look_back)
    gap = int(ctx.p.min_bars)
    ancL = [-1] * n
    ancS = [-1] * n
    dl = deque()
    ds = deque()
    for i in range(n):
        j = i - gap
        if j >= 0:
            if qL[j]:
                while dl and ratio[dl[-1]] <= ratio[j]:
                    dl.pop()
                dl.append(j)
            if qS[j]:
                while ds and ratio[ds[-1]] <= ratio[j]:
                    ds.pop()
                ds.append(j)
        while dl and dl[0] < i - lb:
            dl.popleft()
        while ds and ds[0] < i - lb:
            ds.popleft()
        ancL[i] = dl[0] if dl else -1
        ancS[i] = ds[0] if ds else -1

    # --- per-bar anchored VWAP, underwater count, slope flag, dispersion sigma
    uw = int(ctx.p.uw_win)
    uwm = int(ctx.p.uw_min)
    sl = int(ctx.p.slope_look)

    vwL = [None] * n
    vwS = [None] * n
    okL = [False] * n
    okS = [False] * n
    sgL = [None] * n
    sgS = [None] * n

    pA = -1
    sd = 0.0
    sd2 = 0.0
    cnt = 0
    for i in range(n):
        A = ancL[i]
        if A < 0:
            pA = -1
            continue
        w = avw(A, i)
        if w is None:
            pA = -1
            continue
        vwL[i] = w
        if A != pA:                       # anchor moved -> rebuild dispersion
            sd = 0.0
            sd2 = 0.0
            cnt = 0
            for k in range(A, i + 1):
                wk = avw(A, k)
                if wk is None:
                    continue
                d = tp[k] - wk
                sd += d
                sd2 += d * d
                cnt += 1
            pA = A
        else:
            d = tp[i] - w
            sd += d
            sd2 += d * d
            cnt += 1
        if cnt >= 5:
            var = sd2 / cnt - (sd / cnt) ** 2
            sgL[i] = math.sqrt(var) if var > 0.0 else 0.0
        # under water for uw_min of the last uw_win bars
        lo_k = i - uw + 1
        if lo_k < A:
            lo_k = A
        under = 0
        seen = 0
        for k in range(lo_k, i + 1):
            wk = avw(A, k)
            if wk is None:
                continue
            seen += 1
            if cl[k] < wk:
                under += 1
        if seen >= uw and under >= uwm:
            j = i - sl
            if j >= A:
                wj = avw(A, j)
                if wj is not None and w >= wj:
                    okL[i] = True

    pA = -1
    sd = 0.0
    sd2 = 0.0
    cnt = 0
    for i in range(n):
        A = ancS[i]
        if A < 0:
            pA = -1
            continue
        w = avw(A, i)
        if w is None:
            pA = -1
            continue
        vwS[i] = w
        if A != pA:
            sd = 0.0
            sd2 = 0.0
            cnt = 0
            for k in range(A, i + 1):
                wk = avw(A, k)
                if wk is None:
                    continue
                d = tp[k] - wk
                sd += d
                sd2 += d * d
                cnt += 1
            pA = A
        else:
            d = tp[i] - w
            sd += d
            sd2 += d * d
            cnt += 1
        if cnt >= 5:
            var = sd2 / cnt - (sd / cnt) ** 2
            sgS[i] = math.sqrt(var) if var > 0.0 else 0.0
        lo_k = i - uw + 1
        if lo_k < A:
            lo_k = A
        over = 0
        seen = 0
        for k in range(lo_k, i + 1):
            wk = avw(A, k)
            if wk is None:
                continue
            seen += 1
            if cl[k] > wk:
                over += 1
        if seen >= uw and over >= uwm:
            j = i - sl
            if j >= A:
                wj = avw(A, j)
                if wj is not None and w <= wj:
                    okS[i] = True

    # --- structural stop reference: extreme of the 5 bars before entry
    pre = int(ctx.p.stop_look)
    p5l = [None] * n
    p5h = [None] * n
    for i in range(n):
        j = i - pre + 1
        if j < 0:
            continue
        mn = lo[j]
        mx = hi[j]
        for k in range(j + 1, i + 1):
            if lo[k] < mn:
                mn = lo[k]
            if hi[k] > mx:
                mx = hi[k]
        p5l[i] = mn
        p5h[i] = mx

    ctx.vwL = ctx.series(vwL, "avwap_long")
    ctx.vwS = ctx.series(vwS, "avwap_short")
    ctx.okL = ctx.series(okL, "long_context")
    ctx.okS = ctx.series(okS, "short_context")
    ctx.sgL = ctx.series(sgL, "sigma_long")
    ctx.sgS = ctx.series(sgS, "sigma_short")
    ctx.av = ctx.series(av, "vol_sma")
    ctx.atr = ctx.series(atr, "atr")
    ctx.p5l = ctx.series(p5l, "pre_low")
    ctx.p5h = ctx.series(p5h, "pre_high")


def signal(ctx, i):
    if i < 1:
        return 0
    a = ctx.av[i]
    if a is None or a <= 0.0:
        return 0
    ev = float(ctx.p.entry_vol)
    hot = ctx.v[i] >= ev * a
    if not hot:
        return 0
    c = ctx.c[i]
    if ctx.okL[i]:
        w = ctx.vwL[i]
        if w is not None and c > w and c > ctx.h[i - 1]:
            return 1
    if ctx.okS[i]:
        w = ctx.vwS[i]
        if w is not None and c < w and c < ctx.l[i - 1]:
            return -1
    return 0


def exit_signal(ctx, i):
    """Sigma-band target, hard invalidation through the line, structural stop."""
    if not ctx.positions:
        return False
    p = ctx.positions[0]
    long_ = p["side"] == "long"
    w = ctx.vwL[i] if long_ else ctx.vwS[i]
    a = ctx.atr[i]
    c = ctx.c[i]
    e = p["entry_i"]
    # structural stop, measured from the bars that preceded the entry
    if e >= 1:
        ref = ctx.p5l[e - 1] if long_ else ctx.p5h[e - 1]
        ae = ctx.atr[e]
        if ref is not None and ae is not None:
            pad = float(ctx.p.stop_atr) * ae
            if long_ and c < ref - pad:
                return True
            if (not long_) and c > ref + pad:
                return True
    if w is None or a is None or a <= 0.0:
        return False
    inv = float(ctx.p.invalid_atr) * a
    if long_ and c < w - inv:
        return True
    if (not long_) and c > w + inv:
        return True
    sg = ctx.sgL[i] if long_ else ctx.sgS[i]
    if sg is None or sg <= 0.0:
        return False
    k = float(ctx.p.sig_tp)
    if long_ and c >= w + k * sg:
        return True
    if (not long_) and c <= w - k * sg:
        return True
    return False
